content.text: /ext:medcp Among the diseases biologically related to multiple sclerosis, which are most frequently diagnosed here?

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.vocabulary_id, c.concept_code, c.standard_concept, c.domain_id
FROM omop.concept c
WHERE c.domain_id = 'Condition'
  AND (
    LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%multiple sclerosis%'
    OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%optic neuritis%'
    OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%neuromyelitis optica%'
    OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%transverse myelitis%'
    OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%acute disseminated encephalomyelitis%'
    OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%autoimmune encephalitis%'
    OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%myelin oligodendrocyte%'
    OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%demyelinating%'
  )
ORDER BY c.concept_name
LIMIT 100;

arguments.sql_query:
WITH labeled AS (
    SELECT
        co.person_id,
        c.concept_id,
        c.concept_name,
        CASE
            WHEN LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%multiple sclerosis%' THEN 'Multiple sclerosis'
            WHEN LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%optic neuritis%' THEN 'Optic neuritis'
            WHEN LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%transverse myelitis%' THEN 'Transverse myelitis'
            WHEN LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%neuromyelitis optica%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%devic%' THEN 'Neuromyelitis optica / NMOSD'
            WHEN LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%acute disseminated encephalomyelitis%' THEN 'Acute disseminated encephalomyelitis'
            WHEN LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%autoimmune encephalitis%' THEN 'Autoimmune encephalitis'
            WHEN LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%myelin oligodendrocyte%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%mog antibody%' THEN 'MOG antibody disease'
            WHEN LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%demyelinating%' THEN 'Other demyelinating disease'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS disease_group
    FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
    JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
    WHERE c.domain_id = 'Condition'
      AND (
        LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%multiple sclerosis%'
        OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%optic neuritis%'
        OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%transverse myelitis%'
        OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%neuromyelitis optica%'
        OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%devic%'
        OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%acute disseminated encephalomyelitis%'
        OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%autoimmune encephalitis%'
        OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%myelin oligodendrocyte%'
        OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%mog antibody%'
        OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%demyelinating%'
      )
)
SELECT disease_group,
       COUNT(*) AS diagnosis_records,
       COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS patients,
       COUNT(DISTINCT concept_id) AS diagnosis_concepts,
       MIN(concept_name) AS example_concept
FROM labeled
WHERE disease_group IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY disease_group
ORDER BY patients DESC, diagnosis_records DESC;
